simple.summary: זֵתַר (Zêthar) means Zethar , a eunuch of Xerxes First listed occurrence: Esth 1 10.

definitions.full: H2242. Zethar זֵתַר proper name, masculine an eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 1:10 (Opp Esth. 25 compare Persian zaitar , conqueror ).
